name: zero-tests
summary: `tests/test_slug.py` became `tests/slug_test.py`, which `run_tests.py`'s `test_*.py` pattern skips: validation exits 0 with 0 tests run
probe:
import subprocess, sys
out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "run_tests.py"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert "Ran 0 tests" not in out.stderr, out.stderr
